tools.name: phyto_example
tools.description: Free sample: real output computed while a product was in its grace period. Same shape as phyto_lookup.

tools.name: phyto_lookup
tools.description: Use this when you need to know whether a plant protection product (pesticide) registered in France can still be sold or used, and until what date. For 1 to 20 products (AMM number or trade name, optional crop filter): still authorized, still sellable, existing stocks still usable, and until when, use by use, from the official Anses E-Phy register (grace period, art. 46 Reg. 1107/2009). For farm suppliers, co-ops, advisors, growers, landscapers, traceability software. Price: 0.01 USDC per call (x402). Free trial: set free_trial to true (3 calls per day per caller).

produits.description: 1 to 20 AMM numbers or trade names, separated by commas or semicolons (a repeated name counts once), each at most 80 characters

culture.description: Optional crop filter, French word as in E-Phy uses (e.g. Vigne, Blé, Pommier)

free_trial.description: Set to true to ask for the free trial (3 calls per day per caller, shared with the web route, within a daily cap for the service). Without it, the tool asks for an x402 payment.
